cases.sentence: Ехуд сделал обоюдоострый меч, длиной в локоть , и укрепил его под одеждой у ___.
cases.explain: «правого бедра» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

cases.sentence: Ехуд приблизился к нему (а тот сидел один в верхней комнате своего ___) и сказал:
cases.explain: «летнего дворца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

cases.sentence: Выйдя в переднюю , Ехуд закрыл за собой двери ___ и запер их.
cases.explain: «верхней комнаты» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

cases.sentence: Когда он ушел, слуги обнаружили двери ___ запертыми.
cases.explain: «верхней комнаты» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”
